mapper.select:
select pl.id, pl.log_type, pl.operate_type, pl.content, pl.remark, pl.user_id, pl.created_by, pl.created_time, su.nick_name from pmhub_project_log pl left join sys_user su on su.user_id = pl.user_id where pl.pt_id = #{taskId} and pl.type = 'task'
and pl.log_type = 1 and pl.operate_type = 'editTask'
and pl.log_type = #{logType}
and ( (pl.log_type = 1 and pl.operate_type = 'editTask') or pl.log_type = 2 or pl.log_type = 3 )
order by pl.created_time desc
